title: 環境土木設計演習
subtitle: Design/Exercises in Civil and Environmental Engineering
keywords: Civil Engineering around urban area 2.Ground water 3.Retaining wall 4.Life line
educationalGoal: Students understand problem in constructing underground structure around urban area, and make basic design for them.
advice: This course will impart a solid grounding in Soil Mechanics. The contents are shown as followings. 1. Importance and problem of urban area construction 2. Important points at excavation. 3. Design of retaining wall. 4. Design of well point and consolidation. 5. Refill material and compaction. 6. Possibility of Liquefaction on refilled material. 7. Design parameters from laboratory tests. 8. Propose improvement method under given conditions.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of Soil Mechanics I and II, basic knowledge of Geotechnical Analysis and Fourier Analysis.

activityGoals.body: be able to understand problem of urban constructions.[0.K,0.1M]
be able to design for retaining wall.[0.2K]
be able to propose countermeasures against consolidation. [0.2K]
be able to importance of management of construction. [0.2K,0.2M]

achievementLevels.ideal: Be able to find issues which have high probability of occurrence at urban construction, and propose countermeasures based on Soil Mechanics and Geotechnical Analysis.
achievementLevels.standard: Understand basic concept of urban construction design, and estimate stability and management of burried structure.

lessons.content: Importance and problem of urban construction
Stability of excavation wall and determination of design parameters
Specify water level by pumping up
Estimation of settlement by decreasing of ground water level.
Summaraize and make report under given conditions.
Control of refill material compaction and its problem
Neccesity of re-excavation for under ground structure management
Propose countermeasure against emerging issues through design calculation under given conditions by group.
Preparation of presentation by each group about design results and countermeasures.

lessons.assignments: review of other group's presentation preparation of own presentation
review of other group's presentation preparation of own presentation

lessons.content: (1)Self-Evaluation (2)Evaluation of individual reports and the Rollouts (3)Q&A

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
